relationships.subject: G(1-5)-EM2
relationships.evidence_quote: Calcium mobilization assays revealed that these four chimeric peptides acted as weak mixed agonists for the μ-opioid receptor (MOR), κ-opioid receptor (KOR), and growth hormone secretagogue receptor 1α (GHS-R1α).

key_findings: G(1-5)-EM2 and G(1-9)-EM2 penetrated the BBB after i.v. injection, and G(1-5)-EM2 produced central antinociception via opioid receptors.
Chimeric peptides produced antinociception mainly via MOR, DOR and GHS-R1a with little or no tolerance and reduced digestive side effects.
